news.headline: bids&tenders Awarded National Master Agreement with Kinetic GPO
Expanding verified procurement opportunities for First Nation businesses

paragraphs: bids&tenders sells a digital procurement platform that centralizes procurement activities and streamlines the processes around them. Buyers create and post bids to a branded self-service portal, or send invitations to prequalified suppliers, configuring projects from a template or a custom setup. Registered suppliers, supplier questions and electronic submissions are managed in one central platform, where a compliance checker screens bids before evaluation.

Evaluation templates and online evaluations feed automatic bid analysis and a digital scorecard. Contract management covers contracts, expiry notifications, purchase orders, change orders and insurance certificates online. Reporting tracks spend, team resource loading and upcoming project tasks. Add-on modules offered to agencies include Award Approvals, Contract Builder with DocuSign, Supplier Performance, Open Data and Single Sign-On.

The Kinetic GPO announcement describes an eProcurement platform for public sector organizations across Canada and the United States. The same page states the platform is used by government agencies, municipalities, utilities, healthcare organizations, educational institutions, and engineering and construction firms across Canada and the United States. Since November 2025, bids&tenders has been part of Valsoft Corporation.

quote.text: bids&tenders is a digital procurement platform that helps organizations simplify procurement across the complete procurement lifecycle
